messages:
Noah (AE): Heads-up: Ben's fintech needs Private deploy. Requirements: no SNAT for client IPs, static egress IPs for allowlist, and a contractual burst window (2x baseline for 10-15m). Any immediate blockers?
Ivy (SE): If they require raw L4 client IPs in logs, PrivateLink won't work (ENI will SNAT). TGW or VPC peering is our path. Do they allow TGW attachments?
Ben (Customer): TGW allowed with change control. No managed NAT allowed.
Sam (NetOps): Ops notes: to preserve 5-tuple we must avoid SNAT end-to-end; route their subnets to our connector subnets via TGW/peering. Reserve EIP pool for static egress; avoid on-demand EIPs (quota).
Rosa (Solutions Eng): Quick firewall allowlist snippet: 
- Destination: connector CIDRs (we'll provide)
- Ports: 443 (TLS); 80 (healthchecks)
- DNS: allow outbound to company resolver
Also include route entries to connector subnets in their route table.
Noah (AE): Pricing + SLA q: can we price burst buffer and guarantee?
Ivy (SE): Burst guarantee only with Dedicated reserved capacity and contractual addendum. Ballpark: baseline for 300 rps ~$10k/mo; burst addon ~25-35% extra. Legal to finalize.
Ben (Customer): Please send a short paragraph for our security questionnaire and a mini runbook to validate client IP preservation.
Rosa (Solutions Eng): Draft para: "Redwood Private supports Transit Gateway attachments, VPC peering, and Interface VPC Endpoints. For transport-layer client IP preservation use Transit Gateway or VPC peering and avoid SNAT. Reserved EIP pools or dedicated egress instances provide static egress IPs. If Interface Endpoints are used, client identity can be forwarded at the application layer via X-Forwarded-For headers."
Sam (NetOps): Runbook checks: traceroute/tcpdump to connector EIP, curl health check for latency, ping with MTU size. We'll include SG/route examples.
OpsBot: Preflight checklist created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-egress-checklist
Noah (AE): Next steps: Rosa to send questionnaire paragraph + allowlist by EOD, Sam to validate EIP quotas, schedule sync Fri 9am PT with customer's netsec.
Ben (Customer): Fri 9am PT works. Thanks.
Noah (AE): Will follow up with calendar invite and attach checklist. :thumbsup:
